business.name: Skill Swap
business.summary: A private team workspace for reusable AI skills and plugins. Individual contributions become shared capability through a clear library, independent review and approved releases. The promise is: Your team's know-how, ready to use. The visual identity is warm and editorial. The dimensional logo MUST be built from layered heavyweight paper or card, with broad geometric pieces, controlled folds, substantial thickness, visible edges and restrained fiber texture. Explore three distinct territories: joined modules, a folded shared object, and parts framing an open shared space.
business.audience: Teammates with mixed technical confidence, including newcomers discovering and using AI skills; Builders and trusted approvers maintain the shared library.

concept.metaphor_text: A shared library gives independent team contributions one accessible common place
concept.description: One open U-shaped card has a dark-green upright on the left, a pale-green upright on the right, and a terracotta lower dock. Its two outer upright edges curve outward along broad scores; the lower dock curls forward along a third score. One pale paper core runs continuously through the three colored regions, visible at cut edges. The shared center stays open across the full top, without a backing plate or enclosing border.

plan.hypothesis: Independent contributions become reusable team capability through one open shared library
plan.visual_mechanism: One open U-shaped card has a dark-green upright on the left, a pale-green upright on the right, and a terracotta lower dock. Its two outer upright edges curve outward along broad scores; the lower dock curls forward along a third score. One pale paper core runs continuously through the three colored regions, visible at cut edges. The shared center stays open across the full top, without a backing plate or enclosing border. This develops the open-space territory; retained joined-index and folio studies preserve the other two territories. The SVG uses the exact front projection of these same three assemblies. Dark green, pale green and terracotta follow the supplied palette. No lettering enters the symbol; supplied Manrope and DM Sans remain for adjacent naming. The core contour serves app icons and mono marks, while stock and fold detail belongs to hero views.
assumptions: These are authored alternatives for visual evaluation; owner artistic acceptance remains unknown

details.purpose: Join three contribution regions through one visible shared sheet
details.intended_scale: Broad junctions at app-icon scale; seams and cut edges at hero scale
details.construction: Cut one U-shaped blank from laminated paperboard. Its pale paper core is unbroken through the two upright feet and the lower crossbar. Dark-green, pale-green and terracotta paper-skin regions meet edge-to-edge on the same core; these colors do not denote separate fitted structural parts. Score and bend only the two free outer upright edges and the free bottom edge. Leave both upright-to-crossbar junctions flat and uncut. The three score lines are separate, never crossing each other or those junctions. Every bend carries the same paper stock through a broad curve. The resulting object is one folded card, without joined slabs, floating parts, a top bridge or a backing panel.
details.deletion_test: Cutting the core across either upright foot disconnects that region from the shared dock. A visible gap or an unjoined core would disprove this construction.

details.feature: Broad rounded paper scores and exposed stock
details.purpose: Show a deliberate paper change of plane without treating the sheets as inflated solids
details.intended_scale: Hero and native detail, subordinate to the shared silhouette
details.construction: The two upright returns and the lower forward return are folds of this same blank. Each score has a broad bend radius, leaving visibly substantial stock at its cut edges. The lower junctions remain flat and continuous. Matte fiber-textured paper skins carry the supplied colors; the pale paper core remains visible at cuts. No rigid insert or separate support is added.
details.deletion_test: Removing the scores loses the paper construction; removing the open center loses the accessible shared-space hypothesis.
